half_then_1.title: HALF AT +0.5 SIGMA, HALF AT +1.
half_then_1.doc: Banks half where the parent banks all of it; the rest waits for +1 sigma.

half_then_15.title: HALF AT +0.5 SIGMA, HALF AT +1.5.
half_then_15.doc: Half at the parent's exit, the rest at three times its overshoot.

half_then_2.title: HALF AT +0.5 SIGMA, HALF AT +2.
half_then_2.doc: Half at the parent's exit, the rest held until the laggard is leading.

thirds.title: THIRDS AT +0.5, +1 AND +2 SIGMA.
thirds.doc: A third at each: most of the parent's quick win, and a third left for a big run.

if_basket_rising.title: FURTHER IF THE BASKET IS RISING.
if_basket_rising.doc: Holds for +1.5 sigma when the basket's average momentum is positive (the group is lifting the laggard), and takes +0.5 otherwise.
if_basket_rising.revert_exit:
zs = [r["z"] for r in basket.values() if r]
    rising = zs and sum(zs) / len(zs) > 0
    return [(1.5 if rising else 0.5, 0.0)]

if_volume.title: FURTHER ON HEAVY VOLUME.
if_volume.doc: Holds for +1.5 sigma while the current bar trades at 2x relative volume or more: the rebound is still being bought. Otherwise +0.5.
if_volume.revert_exit:
heavy = (read.get("rvol") or 0) >= 2.0
    return [(1.5 if heavy else 0.5, 0.0)]

if_expanding.title: FURTHER WHILE VOLATILITY EXPANDS.
if_expanding.doc: Holds for +1.5 sigma while short-term volatility is at least 1.3x the long-term: the move is still accelerating. Otherwise +0.5.

if_strong_close.title: FURTHER ON A STRONG CLOSE.
if_strong_close.doc: Holds for +1.5 sigma when the last bar closed in the top fifth of its range. Otherwise +0.5.
if_strong_close.revert_exit:
highs, lows = context.highs(symbol, 1), context.lows(symbol, 1)
    closes = context.closes(symbol, 1)
    strong = False
    if highs and lows and closes and highs[-1] > lows[-1]:
        strong = (closes[-1] - lows[-1]) / (highs[-1] - lows[-1]) >= 0.8
    return [(1.5 if strong else 0.5, 0.0)]

if_gap_wide.title: FURTHER IF THE LEADER IS FAR AHEAD.
if_gap_wide.doc: Holds for +1.5 sigma while the basket's strongest name is still 2 sigma or more ahead of this one: plenty of gap left to close. Otherwise +0.5.
if_gap_wide.revert_exit:
top = max([r["z"] for r in basket.values() if r] or [read["z"]])
    return [(1.5 if top - read["z"] >= 2.0 else 0.5, 0.0)]

if_uptrend.title: FURTHER IN AN UPTREND.
if_uptrend.doc: Holds for +1.5 sigma when the name is above a rising three-session average: a dip inside an uptrend has further to recover. Otherwise +0.5.
if_uptrend.revert_exit:
closes = [float(c) for c in context.closes(symbol, 105)]
    up = False
    if len(closes) >= 105:
        now, before = sum(closes[-78:]) / 78, sum(closes[-104:-26]) / 78
        up = closes[-1] > now > before
    return [(1.5 if up else 0.5, 0.0)]
